question: Can a small, cheaply measurable subset of a REBCO tape's critical-current data predict its withheld low-temperature, high-field critical current in perpendicular field?
evidence_class: registered retrospective hold-out on public measured data
seen_status: Ic values of every product are unanalysed at freeze time except the 20-40 K data of the products already embedded in data/materials (faraday-factory-japan-ybco, shanghai-superconductor-high-field-low-temperature, superpower-advanced-pinning, theva-pro-line-advanced-pinning), which earlier Converra studies used. Those four are reported as a separate 'previously_used' stratum.

data.source: Robinson Research Institute HTS critical current database, figshare collection 2861821 (CC BY 4.0)
data.quantity: ic_a_per_m (critical current per unit tape width, A/m)
data.products_in_headline: every dataset in sources.json except those flagged not_a_tape

node_definition.temperature: nominal_temperature_k when present; otherwise measured temperature_k rounded to the nearest 0.5 K
node_definition.field: nominal_field_t when present; otherwise measured applied_field_t snapped to the nearest value of the standard grid [0, 0.01, 0.015, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.07, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8] when within max(0.002 T, 2%) of it, else the row is not a node member
node_definition.angle: nominal_angle_deg when present; otherwise measured angle_from_normal_deg rounded to the nearest 5 deg
node_definition.perpendicular: angle node congruent to 0 modulo 180 deg (both field-normal orientations)
node_definition.node_value: minimum ic_a_per_m over all rows belonging to the (temperature, field, perpendicular) node, i.e. the weaker of the two normal orientations and of any repeated measurements
node_definition.self_field_value: median ic_a_per_m over rows at temperature node 77.5 K and field node 0 T, all angles

targets.rule: every (T, B) target node present in the product's data

S0_self_field_lift.prediction: self_field_value(product) x median over all OTHER headline products having both quantities of [node_value(T,B) / self_field_value] at the same target node (leave-one-product-out population lift factor)
S0_self_field_lift.pre_declared_expectation: FAIL, following Senatore et al. 2016 (no univocal correlation between 77 K self-field and low-temperature high-field Ic)

S1_scanner.role: what a reel-to-reel in-field scanner can provide
S1_scanner.training_nodes: perpendicular nodes with temperature in [65, 77.5] K and field in [0.5, 4] T
S1_scanner.pre_declared_expectation: uncertain; extrapolation from 65-77.5 K to 20-40 K is a factor of roughly 3-5 in temperature distance to Tc

S2_scanner_plus_anchor.role: scanner data plus one short-sample in-field measurement at low temperature
S2_scanner_plus_anchor.training_nodes: S1 training nodes plus the single perpendicular node at 30 K and 3 T

M1.form: ln Ic = c0 - T / Tstar - alpha * ln B   (three parameters c0, Tstar, alpha; Senatore et al. 2016 Eq. 2 in log form, perpendicular field)
M1.fit: ordinary least squares in ln Ic over the scenario's training nodes, linear in (c0, 1/Tstar, alpha); B in tesla, T in kelvin
M1.uncertainty: 95% prediction interval in ln Ic from the OLS residual variance, parameter covariance and the Student t quantile with (n_train - 3) degrees of freedom; reported, coverage is not gating

M2.status: secondary, reported only, cannot change any verdict
M2.form: ln Ic = c0 - T / Tstar - (a0 + a1 * T) * ln B   (four parameters)
M2.fit: ordinary least squares in ln Ic, same training nodes

metrics.relative_error: e = predicted / measured - 1 at each target node
metrics.worst_overprediction: max e over the product's target nodes
metrics.p95_abs_error: 95th percentile of |e| over the product's target nodes (linear interpolation, numpy default)
metrics.interval_coverage: fraction of target nodes whose measured value lies inside the 95% prediction interval (M1 only; reported)

product.NOT_EVALUATED: fewer training nodes than the scenario minimum, no target nodes, a missing S2 anchor, or a missing self-field value for S0
product.INCONCLUSIVE: fit numerically degenerate (non-finite parameters or Tstar <= 0)

scenario_headline.PASS: at least 80% of evaluated headline products PASS
scenario_headline.note: per-product verdicts are the primary result; the headline summarises them

verdicts.tolerance_rationale: 10% overprediction matches the declared conductor-capacity budget used in OC-005/OC-006; overprediction is limited more tightly than underprediction because overpredicted capacity is unsafe in allocation.

software_gates.G1_synthetic_recovery: data generated exactly from M1 with known parameters on each product's training/target node layout is recovered to relative parameter error <= 1e-9 and target relative error <= 1e-9
software_gates.G2_independent_checker: a separate checker recomputes every node value, prediction, metric and verdict from the prepared CSVs and the protocol, and must agree exactly with the runner's output
software_gates.G3_coverage_accounting: every product appears with a verdict for every scenario; no product is dropped

falsifiers: If S0 PASSes the headline, the stated premise that 77 K self-field does not predict in-field performance is contradicted for this database and must be reported as such.
If S1 or S2 FAIL, the failure stands; the model, tolerances and node definitions are not changed to recover a PASS. Any revised method is a new protocol version, run as a new scored attempt.

outputs.runs: runs/cr01/<attempt>/ (ignored): runner output JSON with every node value, prediction, interval, metric and verdict
